core_principles: Calm & Reflective: Interface should never overwhelm the user.
Intelligently Organized: Progressive disclosure hides complexity.
Emotionally Lightweight: Avoid enterprise dashboard density and aggressive alerts.
Tactile & Premium: Soft hover states, organic color palette, distinct typography.

primary_font.usage: Main UI, body text, functional labels, task titles

secondary_font.usage: Reflective sections (Notes, Journaling, Year/Goal Headers, Memory Resurfacing)

scale.caption: text-sm text-stone-500 dark:text-stone-400 font-sans
scale.overline: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-sans text-stone-400 dark:text-stone-500

spacing_and_layout.spacing_scale: Use Tailwind generous spacing: p-6, p-8, p-12. Avoid cramped layouts (p-2/p-4) for major sections. Whitespace is a luxury tool here.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Bento-style 'Control Room' grid but highly spacious. gap-6 or gap-8 between widgets. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Widgets must stretch 'h-full'.
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: Slim, minimal layout (bg-elevated). Soft hover states. No bright active colors, use bold text + higher contrast icon. Include PARA (Projects, Areas, Resources, Archives) elegantly.
spacing_and_layout.task_card: Flat surface (bg-surface), 1px subtle border (border-default). NO heavy drop shadows. Very subtle diffuse shadow (shadow-sm) on hover. Rounded corners (rounded-2xl).
spacing_and_layout.progressive_disclosure: Hide less important actions behind a smooth fade on hover or inside a context menu. Display only critical data (Task Name, Priority indicator) at first glance.

buttons.primary: bg-text-primary text-background-base rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 hover:opacity-90 transition-opacity font-sans
buttons.secondary: bg-background-elevated text-text-primary border border-borders-default rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 hover:bg-borders-default transition-colors font-sans
buttons.ghost: text-text-secondary hover:bg-background-elevated hover:text-text-primary rounded-xl px-4 py-2 transition-colors font-sans

components.inputs: bg-transparent border-b border-borders-default focus:border-text-primary focus:ring-0 px-0 py-2 text-text-primary placeholder:text-text-muted outline-none transition-colors
components.checkbox: w-5 h-5 rounded-md border-2 border-borders-focus text-text-primary focus:ring-text-primary focus:ring-offset-background-base transition-all cursor-pointer

motion_philosophy.principles: Calm, slow, and purposeful. No bouncy or erratic animations. Progressive fade-ins for cards.
motion_philosophy.durations: duration-300 to duration-500 for state changes.
motion_philosophy.easing: ease-out for entering elements, ease-in-out for state changes. Use framer-motion-like spring settings if available, or Tailwind smooth easings.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using Vue 3 (Composition API), Vite, Tailwind CSS, Pinia, and Dexie.js (for local-first IndexedDB storage).
Do NOT use React, Next.js, or Shadcn for React. Use pure Vue 3 components, styled via Tailwind with the defined palette.

Extend Tailwind config (tailwind.config.js) with the provided light/dark colors via CSS variables (e.g., 'surface': 'var(--color-surface)') and font families ('sans': ['Manrope', 'sans-serif'], 'serif': ['Newsreader', 'serif']).
Ensure the priority matrix is strictly derived from 'Important' and 'Urgent' booleans. Map these directly to the Priority Matrix colors defined above.
For the 'Finance Snapshot', use simple, clean typography-driven data blocks or minimal sparklines (no dense enterprise charts).
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive and key informational elements for robust testing (e.g., data-testid='task-checkbox-urgent', data-testid='sidebar-nav-projects').
Implement the 'Command Palette' pattern for keyboard-centric global search and quick capture.
